test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Hard/tough nut to crack

options.text: A difficult person, problem or situation
Not being able to enjoy oneself

solution:
The correct answer is "**A difficult person, problem or situation**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An idiom is a group of words, or in other words, a phrase that has a meaning different from the literal meaning of the words in it. 
 
 
• Example: "Under the weather" means feeling ill or getting a cold.
 
 
 
• **The idiom "hard/tough nut to crack" refers to a challenging or difficult person, problem, or situation.**
 
• It implies that the task at hand requires a lot of effort and skill to accomplish.
 
 
• Example: The new project is a hard nut to crack, but with teamwork and dedication, we can succeed.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**
